Crystal Events._comment: Groups together Crystal checks for logic rules (bosses + warp room access).

Clear Gems._comment: Location group which also controls whether Clear Gem checks are made.

Colored Gems (Items)._comment: Item group which also controls whether Clear Gem items are made.

Colored Gems (Locations)._comment: Location group which also controls whether Colored Gem checks are made.

Yellow Gem Category._comment: Controls whether Yellow Gem is made. Requires warp 6 to be part of the world.

Colored Gem Events._comment: Groups together colored gem checks for the Bug Lite gem path rule.

Sapphire Relic Events._comment: Groups together Sapphire Relic checks for logic rules (warp 6 access).

Gold Relic Events._comment: Groups together Gold Relic checks for logic rules (Gold Relic Goal).

Platinum Relic Events._comment: Groups together Platinum Relic checks for logic rules (Platinum Relic Goal).

Sapphire Relics._comment: Location group which also controls whether Sapphire Relic items and and locations are made.

Gold Relics._comment: Location group which also controls whether Gold Relic locations are made (via overridden before_is_category_enabled in hooks/Helpers.py).

Platinum Relics._comment: Location group which also controls whether Platinum Relic locations are made (via overridden before_is_category_enabled in hooks/Helpers.py).

Warp Unlocks._comment: Item group which also controls whether warp unlocks are made.

Warp 6._comment: Location group which also controls whether warp 6 locations are made.

Dino Might! Clear Gems._comment: Controls whether the Dino Might! Clear Gem locations are made. They require the Yellow Gem, which is not guaranteed to exist.

Eggipus Rex._comment: Location group which also controls whether Eggipus Rex locations are made.

Bug Lite Path._comment: Controls whether the Colored Gem path location is made. It requires all 5 Colored Gems, but Yellow Gem isn't guaranteed to exist.

Ski Crazed._comment: Location group which also controls whether Ski Crazed locations are made.

Area 51?._comment: Location group which also controls whether Area 51? locations are made.

Rings of Power._comment: Location group which also controls whether Rings of Power locations are made.
